input.command:
MSG=$(mktemp)
cat > "$MSG" <<'EOF'
feature: add Heals Plans and a home plan carousel

https://app.clickup.com/t/8553538/TECH-9380

The profile menu still showed Heals Pass and opened the old plan page. Replace that entry with Heals Plans and open a list that separates upcoming and past plans, so a member can activate or share a plan that is not yet activated.

The home page had no plan cards, and My Plans always opened on the first plan. Show the member's plans after login, keep an owned plan from appearing locked before policy data loads, and open My Plans on the selected plan.
EOF
TREE=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')
PARENT=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^')
NEW=$(git commit-tree "$TREE" -p "$PARENT" --author="cham1985 <397866153@qq.com>" -F "$MSG")
git update-ref HEAD "$NEW"
rm -f "$MSG"
git log -1 --format='%H%n%an %ae%n%B'
git status -sb

MSG=$(mktemp)
cat > "$MSG" <<'EOF'
feature: add Heals Plans and a home plan carousel

https://app.clickup.com/t/8553538/TECH-9380

The profile menu still showed Heals Pass and opened the old plan page. Replace that entry with Heals Plans and open a list that separates upcoming and past plans, so a member can activate or share a plan that is not yet activated.

The home page had no plan cards, and My Plans always opened on the first plan. Show the member's plans after login, keep an owned plan from appearing locked before policy data loads, and open My Plans on the selected plan.
EOF
TREE=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')
PARENT=$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^')
AUTHOR_DATE=$(git log -1 --format=%aD)
COMMITTER_DATE=$(git log -1 --format=%cD)
NEW=$(GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='cham1985' GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='397866153@qq.com' GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="$AUTHOR_DATE" GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='cham1985' GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='397866153@qq.com' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="$COMMITTER_DATE" git commit-tree "$TREE" -p "$PARENT" -F "$MSG")
git update-ref HEAD "$NEW"
rm -f "$MSG"
echo "NEW=$NEW"
git log -1 --format='%H%n%an %ae%n%B'
git status -sb
git push origin HEAD && git status -sb && git log -1 --format='%H%n%B'
